links.outcome: Chatbot drug-drug interaction detection accuracy versus subscription DDI reference tool
links.effect: Specificity ranged from 0.372 (ChatGPT-3.5) to 0.769 (Bing AI); accuracy 0.469 (ChatGPT-3.5) to 0.788 (Bing AI) against subscription reference.
links.quote: When a subscription tool was used as a reference, the specificity ranged from a low of 0.372 (ChatGPT-3.5) to a high of 0.769 (Microsoft Bing AI).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy) of commercial LLM chatbots (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Bing AI, Bard) against reference drug-drug interaction databases on a set of 255 drug pairs.
